query:
SELECT
                    m.id "id: i32",
                    m.dm_filename,
                    m.name,
                    m.file_id "file_id: i32",
                    m.icon_file_id "icon_file_id: i32",
                    m.crc
                FROM mods m
                INNER JOIN game_mods gm ON
                    gm.mod_id=m.id AND
                    gm.game_id=$1
